title: Sources: Apple and Intel have reached a formal deal in recent months for Intel to manufacture some chips for Apple devices (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Sources: Apple and Intel have reached a formal deal in recent months for Intel to manufacture some chips for Apple devices — The iPhone maker and U.S. silicon giant will work together on chips for Apple devices. The Trump administration pushed for the deal.
contentText:
Wall Street Journal :

Sources: Apple and Intel have reached a formal deal in recent months for Intel to manufacture some chips for Apple devices; INTC jumps 15%+   —  The iPhone maker and U.S. silicon giant will work together on chips for Apple devices.  The Trump administration pushed for the deal.
